label: About
title: About Ivory Procession Law Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1211 recent saved-signal files and 315 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around The first A-Corp law is here and Detroit Is Changing Fast. Here’s What Locals Think Its Future Should Look Like, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Ivory Procession Law Field: Ivory procession law field, poster crop, overhead scan: lock a left/right biptych with thin gray grid on the left and a severe blank legal-paper field on the right. One oversized cropped matte-black angular slab dominates the gridded half. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against matte black cropped angular slab, soft gray vertical civic seam, and left gridded paper field.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
